sessionCookie.description: Opaque DB-backed session token (HMAC at rest, never a JWT). HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=86400 (24h). Single-use revocation semantics; logout marks the row revoked and bumps the per-customer account-token revocation floor.

info.description: Self-serve customer portal: email-OTP / magic-link sign-in, read-only session-scoped entitlement/device/usage views, and per-action seat operations (checkout/heartbeat/release/download) proxied to the licensing backend via an ephemeral, session-scoped account token. Every authenticated route binds the session-derived customer_id; no client-supplied customer_id or fingerprint reaches a mutation chokepoint. This document describes the routes the Worker actually serves and is pinned to the source by a build-time cross-check test.
info.title: licensecc Customer Portal Worker

post.description: Server-resolves entitlement_id -> project/feature/fingerprint from the customer's active entitlements (invariant 4). Mints an ephemeral 120s session-scoped account token (never returned to the browser), proxies to the backend, then wraps the backend response in a portal envelope.

200.description: Portal envelope with backend checkout response in data.

400.description: Body was not JSON (invalid_json), or portal/backend checkout validation rejected it (invalid_request).

401.description: No / invalid portal session (unauthorized), or the backend account token was rejected, revoked, or expired.

403.description: Cross-site request rejected, or backend checkout returned a documented policy denial.

404.description: entitlement_id not owned or not active (generic — no existence oracle).

409.description: Backend checkout could not reserve a concurrent seat because the pool was exhausted.

500.description: The portal failed unexpectedly, or backend checkout failed to sign/verify the seat response.

502.description: Backend was unreachable or its response was not valid JSON.

503.description: BACKEND_ORIGIN is absent or invalid (backend_unconfigured), portal token minting is misconfigured (config_error), or the backend cannot sign a seat assertion (seat_signing_unavailable) / verify its request.

post.summary: Seat checkout. Server-resolves the entitlement id, mints a 120s account token, proxies to backend /v1/checkout.

post.description: Resolves the device through the SAME ownership EXISTS as the devices listing (invariant 4 — a foreign or absent device is the generic not_found, never a 403 oracle). Atomically bumps the entitlement revocation_seq, flips the device out of 'active', and appends a portal_device_release audit event with the session customer id. Re-releasing an already-released device is a 409.

500.description: The atomic device-release and audit transaction could not be completed.

post.summary: Self-serve device deactivation. Frees the slot a registered device holds.

post.description: Server-resolves entitlement_id, mints a 120s token, proxies to backend /v1/activate with device_key_id, then converts the backend JSON lic field to an attachment. Strips upstream Authorization / Set-Cookie so the ephemeral bearer never reaches the browser. The portal never parses or signs (invariant 1).

403.description: Cross-site request rejected, or backend activate returned a documented entitlement/device policy denial.

post.description: The ONLY path that returns a secret. Gated by a constant-time bearer (PORTAL_BOOTSTRAP_BEARER; unset -> 404, no existence oracle), an optional Cloudflare Access network gate (PORTAL_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRE_ACCESS=1), always-on rate limiting, and an append-only audit row. For an unknown email the secret is null (no enumeration).

secret.description: The OTP secret, or null for an unknown email.

200.description: OTP issued; secret returned once (null for an unknown email).

400.description: Body was not a JSON object (invalid_json) or email empty after trim/lower (invalid_request).

403.description: Cloudflare Access required (PORTAL_BOOTSTRAP_REQUIRE_ACCESS=1 and cf-access-jwt-assertion missing) — access_required; or cross_site_forbidden.

404.description: PORTAL_BOOTSTRAP_BEARER unset — the route does not exist (no existence oracle).

post.summary: Operator break-glass: issue an OTP and return the secret directly (never emailed).

post.description: No auth required (the session is optional — logout is idempotent). Marks the session row revoked and bumps account_token_revocations.revocation_seq to kill any in-flight 120s account token (invariant 9). Always clears the cookie (Max-Age=0).

200.description: Logged out. Clears the lccp_session cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: lccp_session=; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=0

400.description: Body was not a JSON object (when Content-Type: application/json).

403.description: Cross-site request rejected (Sec-Fetch-Site not same-origin, or Origin does not match PORTAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN).

post.summary: Revoke the session and clear the cookie (idempotent).

get.description: The magic-link secret arrives in ?token=<secret> but is NEVER consumed on this GET (prevents referer/prefetch leaks — invariant 6). Returns an auto-submitting HTML form, not JSON. Headers: referrer-policy: no-referrer; cache-control: no-store.

parameters.description: Magic-link secret (base64url, 32 bytes). Echoed into a hidden form field on this origin only; never consumed here.
parameters.name: token

get.summary: Magic-link interstitial (HTML). Renders a self-submitting form that POSTs the token to /magic-redeem.

post.description: Accepts the token either as JSON { token } or as application/x-www-form-urlencoded token=<secret> (posted by the interstitial form). The request body is capped at 8192 bytes before parsing; multipart and other media types are rejected. Email-independent; single-use via an atomic UPDATE. On success sets the lccp_session cookie.

200.description: Signed in. Sets the lccp_session cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: lccp_session=<opaque>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=86400

400.description: Body was not valid JSON or application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

401.description: Invalid OTP (wrong/consumed/expired/over-cap secret), or unauthorized config_error from redeemOtp.

403.description: Cross-site request rejected (Sec-Fetch-Site not same-origin, or Origin does not match PORTAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN).

415.description: Content-Type must be application/json or application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

post.summary: Redeem a magic-link token and mint an opaque session.

post.description: Always returns ok (no customer enumeration). Schedules the email via ctx.waitUntil when configured. The secret is NEVER returned on this path (only via the operator bootstrap). Always-on rate limiting (per-email 5/900s + per-IP 30/900s, fail-closed).

200.description: OTP requested (or a no-op for an unknown email — identical shape).

400.description: Body was not a JSON object.

403.description: Cross-site request rejected (Sec-Fetch-Site not same-origin, or Origin does not match PORTAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN).

post.summary: Request an OTP (numeric code + magic link) for an email.

post.description: Email-bound: a wrong code and an unknown OTP are byte-identical (invalid_otp, no oracle on the reason). Single-use atomic claim (consumed_at). On success sets the lccp_session cookie.

200.description: Signed in. Sets the lccp_session cookie.

Set-Cookie.description: lccp_session=<opaque>; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/; Max-Age=86400

400.description: Body was not a JSON object.

401.description: Invalid OTP (wrong/consumed/expired/over-cap code), or unauthorized config_error from redeemOtp. Byte-identical for all failure reasons.

403.description: Cross-site request rejected (Sec-Fetch-Site not same-origin, or Origin does not match PORTAL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN).
